channel.title: Sid Shekhar — Writing
channel.description: Essays and on-chain data analysis by Sid Shekhar.

item.title: 104 matches. 48 teams. 39 days. How to maximize EV from the 2026 World Cup.
item.description: The 2026 World Cup is a closed system — 48 teams, 104 matches, ~9,500 correlated Polymarket markets and a hard resolution date. What the Champions League data says about how to trade it.

item.title: Lessons from 18 months of building agents that handle real money (at scale)
item.description: What $5M+ in volume and 100K+ transactions taught us about building AI agents that execute with real capital — code for math, prompts for judgment, plans before code, and memory as plain files.

item.title: From conversation to execution: lessons learned evaluating 6+ LLMs for Gina
item.description: We evaluated six-plus LLMs on real user tasks in Gina — market data lookups, chart generation and on-chain swaps — measuring speed, tool-calling accuracy, transaction success and UX.

item.title: 7 Years in Crypto
item.description: Seven years full-time in crypto — starting TokenAnalyst in the ICO era, getting acquired by Coinbase pre-IPO, and what comes next.

item.title: Channels & Crypto Natives
item.description: A data-driven examination of community formation via channels on Farcaster.

item.title: Quantifying Vibes
item.description: A data-driven look at what makes Farcaster engaging — question askers, reply guys, long-form lovers, tippers and builders, measured across a week of open cast data.

item.title: Under the hood of the world computer
item.description: Most blockchain analysis stops at transactions. A look at Ethereum through traces, sub-traces and decoded function calls — and what it takes to gather that data at scale.

item.title: Jackpot — A Fomo3D adventure
item.description: On-chain forensics on the address that won 10,469 ETH from Fomo3D — was it a bot, a coordinated scheme, or just very well prepared?

item.title: Measuring Maker-Dai stability
item.description: One anomalous bar in MKR transfer data led to CDP #614 — a forensic walk through how the Maker-Dai system absorbed a large liquidation event in March 2018.

item.title: Dissecting Blocks
item.description: The case for why examining who is transacting on-chain — not just how much — is the key to fundamentally understanding and valuing cryptoassets.
